FloPlast 110mm push-fit soil pipes are designed for efficient wastewater management and form essential components of any drainage system. Manufactured from robust uPVC for strength and long-lasting durability, these lightweight black soil stack pipes facilitate straightforward installation. The single socket design and push-fit system with ring seal joints allow for quick and secure connections, ideal for plumbers and builders installing new soil stacks or undertaking repair work. They are also suitable for handling high temperature waste discharges, ensuring reliable performance in various applications. Supplied as a convenient 2-pack, each pipe measures 3m, providing a total of 6m for project requirements.
